profile.name: Joshi Astrals
profile.creator: The House of Joshi
profile.tagline: Rooted in Earth. Written in the stars.
profile.description:
7,777 cosmic companions where nature, mathematical patterns and celestial imagination meet. Crafted from lavender stone, sea glass, iridescent pearl and obsidian, each Astral combines expressive personality, elemental details and a little Web3 spirit.

Four elemental families share one universe, while The Celestial Twelve feature one unique edition for each zodiac sign. Discover your companion through layered artwork, uplifting messages and patterns inspired by science and mathematics.

Rooted in Earth. Written in the stars.
